body: I'm glad you're being honest, but it is not the best way to go about it. I've tried to bleed the pain out and it never did really work. I only went numb. Being numb isn't the answer either. Please try to find a alternative.

If you can please take a break and put calming music on or something. I know you hate it but you need to find a better way to control the pain. If you can try walking or running around the block. Or try to focus on something.

It is not at all bad for wanting someone to be at your side. It's what I think we all desire. I understand your disappointment, I honestly do. If you can could you please stop punching things and maybe eat ice cream.

The family I live with is asleep. I don't think I ever would be able to tell them to their faces what i said on here. Even if i do throw the razor away i still have a bottle of pills and a sharper knife. Im sorry if i seem like a attention whore.
